title: koeleria vallesiana var. mediterranea
intro: Koeleria vallesiana var. mediterranea, commonly known as Mediterranean Koeleria, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is native to the Mediterranean region and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Koeleria vallesiana var. mediterranea include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antihistaminic, and antispasmodic effects.
